title: Summary Boxes, Option A
subtitle: Under each number on the Financial Summary and the Spending tab, what makes it up is listed one item per line, with the amounts lined up on the right.
intro: The code is already in your Sheet. The upgrade redraws the Spending tab and the Financial Summary; your Month, Compare with and months settings stay as they are.
**What does not change:** the big numbers. Only the lines underneath and the box sizes change.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before option A boxes 2026-11-26`.
Reload the Sheet. Open the **App Setup** tab and check that **Build Script Version** reads `1.35.0`. If it shows an older number, wait a minute and reload again.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.

steps.done: Each of the four boxes has its number, then a short list: for example **Fixed Costs** shows Bills, Debt payments and Utilities (avg), each with its amount on the right.
**Expected Take-Home** lists each paycheck, then Landed so far. **Recurring bills** lists the bill groups largest first, then Active bills and Paid this month.

steps.text: Look for any line that is cut off or sits beside the wrong amount.
steps.done: If you see one, tell Claude which box.
